correctness.rationale: The deck-group orbits are ell-separated, giving a short interval with at most double fibers. Integrating the overcount of projected disks gives the 1/2 sum of geodesic disk overlaps. The local length gap isolates primitive conjugacy classes of systoles; Fermi-coordinate unfolding gives per-systole orbital integral ell*int L(r,d_ell(t))cosh t dt. The displacement d_ell(t)=ell+a*t^2+O(t^4), a=tanh(ell/2), and hyperbolic lens tangency L=(4/3)*sqrt(a)*h^(3/2)+... lead by a beta integral to I=2pi*ell*eps^2+O(eps^3), independently symbolically checked. Thus the deficit and negative derivative jump follow; the F small-radius coefficient gives A, first deficit gives ell, jump gives k. No global length-spectrum inversion or uniformity across degenerating surfaces is claimed.
residual_risks: Independent check is bounded to the stated finite ranges; any unrestricted proof rests on analyzed mathematics rather than numerical output.
